policies.title: Singaporean ordinary passports: advance Liberia visitor visa
policies.summary: Singapore's current passport-specific guidance requires Singaporeans to obtain a visa before travel. Liberia's separate airport-sticker service is residence and mission-availability conditioned and is not an electronic visa.
conditions: Ordinary Singapore passport and short visitor travel only.
Obtain the visitor visa before travel under Singapore's current passport-specific advice.

Liberia's separate preapproved airport-sticker route depends on residence and whether a Liberian mission serves that location; it is retained as a conditional exception rather than a passport-wide baseline.
Passport validity, yellow-fever documentation, security conditions and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Singaporean ordinary passports: Guinea-Bissau visa on arrival
policies.summary: Singapore's current passport-specific advice expressly gives Singaporeans a visa issued on arrival for stays up to 90 days.
conditions: Ordinary Singapore passport and short visitor travel only.
Stay up to 90 days under the stated arrival-visa route.
Passport must remain valid for at least six months; health, security and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Singaporean ordinary passports: advance Niger visitor visa

conditions: Ordinary Singapore passport and short visitor travel only.

Security, health and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Korean ordinary passports: advance Central African Republic visitor visa
policies.summary: Korea's current passport-specific profile requires a visa, excludes arrival issuance and identifies diplomatic missions that issue the entry visa.
conditions: Ordinary Republic of Korea passport and short visitor travel only.
Obtain the visa through a Central African Republic mission or the identified French Embassy handling route before travel.
Passport validity, supporting documents, health, security and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Korean ordinary passports: permit-conditioned Sudan visa on arrival
policies.summary: Korea's current passport-specific profile says a Sudan Entry Permit must be issued in advance and the physical Entry Visa is then issued at the airport.
conditions: Ordinary Republic of Korea passport and short visitor travel only.
Obtain the Sudan Entry Permit before travel, carry its copy and arrange separate submission of the original to the Sudanese airport office.
The airport-issued visa is stated as US$100; foreigner registration is required within 72 hours and travel beyond Khartoum needs a separate permit.
The Republic of Korea's temporary passport-use prohibition for Sudan requires exceptional Korean authorization and is an outbound-law condition, not the destination's visa issuance point.

policies.title: Mexican ordinary passports: advance Liberia visitor visa
policies.summary: Mexico's current passport-specific guidance requires Mexican tourists to obtain the Liberia visa before travel through the Washington Embassy's postal process and expressly excludes arrival issuance.
conditions: Ordinary Mexican passport and short tourist travel only.
Apply by post through the Liberian Embassy in Washington before travel; Mexico's guidance states a ten-business-day wait and warns that airlines will not board travellers without the visa.
A residence-conditioned airport-sticker service is not generalized over the exact Mexican passport-specific mission route.
Passport validity, health, security and final admission remain separate.

conflicts.explanation: Singapore's current passport-specific guidance requires a visa before travel, while Liberia's separate preapproved airport-sticker service is residence-conditioned rather than an eVisa entitlement for every Singapore passport holder.
Korea's current passport-specific profile places physical visa issuance at the Sudanese airport after a required Entry Permit is issued in advance.
Mexico's current passport-specific guidance requires postal mission issuance before travel and expressly says the visa cannot be obtained on arrival.

unresolved.reason: Korea's current page directly rejects arrival issuance and visa-less admission but does not identify one safe advance or electronic replacement route.
